title: Weatherford Announces Court Approval and Expected Closing Date for U.S. Redomestication
body_markdown:
HOUSTON, Oct. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Weatherford International plc (NASDAQ: WFRD) (“Weatherford” or the “Company”) today announced that the High Court of Ireland has approved the previously announced scheme of arrangement through which the Company intends to change its legal domicile from Ireland to Delaware.


Weatherford expects to complete the redomestication on November 13, 2026, subject to the satisfaction of customary closing conditions. Upon completion, Weatherford International Corp, a Delaware corporation, will become the publicly traded parent company of the Weatherford group.


The redomestication will not change the Company’s operations, management, business strategy or headquarters. Weatherford’s shares are expected to continue trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker symbol “WFRD.”


Additional information regarding the redomestication is available in Weatherford’s filings with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.


**About Weatherford**


Weatherford is a global energy services company that helps customers drill smarter, complete wells more effectively, and maximize production across the entire well lifecycle. With a differentiated portfolio of market-leading solutions, integrated technologies, and a broad global customer footprint across six continents, we blend advanced engineering, digital intelligence, and world-class field expertise to reduce risk, improve performance, and maximize the value of customer assets. Together, we elevate every operation, delivering stronger wells, sharper decisions, and better energy for the world. Visit weatherford.com for more information and connect with us on social media.
